_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil regime with 30d momentum/funding pinned and no visible breaker makes HOLD the base-rate call; stay on Hope rung until range or funding/volume expands.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit HOLD/CAUTION coil; narrative silent on forward phase and only reports rising greed, so split resolved toward higher-trust analyst
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC 30d change stays inside roughly ±5% and fear/greed holds 50-70 without funding or volume expansion
next_move.invalidated_if: 30d momentum leaves the 40-60 band on a range break, or funding plus retail velocity expand together, or a VIX/gold impulse knocks sentiment down through Anxiety
